records.measurement_scope: Full original matrix workflow and resumed completion. Wall elapsed includes interruption/suspension, not active work; current request interval is separately recorded. Publication/Git transport after verification closure excluded.
measurement_limitations: Nested process wrappers and historical unwrapped commands prevent a complete nonduplicated CPU total; original recorded per-run CPU remains available.
Overlapping workers were not observed by one joint RSS sampler; no sum/maximum is presented as the complete concurrent peak.
Tool memory excludes model servers and desktop agent. Unknown observations stay null; no invented allocation by case/goal.
Final provider events after the stated closed verification/actor boundaries and Git publication are outside this verification cost scope.
